motion: build/break (spawn sparkle -> solid block -> radiating cracks)
note: COLOUR-SHIFT (clut) cousin of block_sprites: SAME raised-frame + recessed-centre tile, but a warm CREAM frame (two-tone: cream edge + neutral grey inner bevel) around RED/crimson/brown centres (block_sprites is a GREY frame + blue/green). Unlike the static block_sprites it carries the BUILD (f02-f06 cream 4-point spawn sparkle, points to the corners, filling toward a square) and BREAK (solid f19/f49 -> cracked f20/f50) frames; the crimson variant also has a red/green stud row on the well's top inner edge. 51 source frames = spawn sparkle + per-colour variant groups [solid32 + cracked32 + 4x small16].
